_comment: Candidate rainfall sources for the 2015 event. Values marked (expected) are general expectations to be CONFIRMED from the provider documentation before use; nothing here has been downloaded. Source selection is pending the user's/Agent 1's decision. No download logic exists for any source yet.

sources.anomaly_baseline: feasible if multi-decade same-source record is obtained
sources.existing_code: scripts/process_rainfall.py downloads daily files (2023 sample only); previous download failures were never diagnosed
sources.cautions: 5 km cells: only a few cells intersect Chennai; smooths convective extremes

sources.day_definition: UNCONFIRMED (observing-day convention differs from UTC calendar days)
sources.cautions: coarser; gauge density and format (binary/NetCDF) to be confirmed; licence/access to be confirmed

sources.unit: m of water, ACCUMULATED over a forecast window (expected)
sources.day_definition: UNCONFIRMED (expected UTC-based; accumulations need de-accumulation, source-specific logic NOT implemented)
sources.cautions: model precipitation, not an observation; known to differ from gauges for extremes

sources.product_type: satellite-blended (IMERG Late V07 disaggregation of station-adjusted pentads; DAILY_SAT)
sources.native_resolution: 0.05 deg (verified live: EPSG:4326, Earth Engine grid 0.0500000007 deg)
sources.day_definition: PROVISIONAL / NOT VERIFIED (daily labels are disaggregation labels, not verified local observation-day windows)
sources.licence: DISCREPANCY: Earth Engine says public domain, CHC says CC BY 4.0; attribute under CC BY 4.0
sources.existing_code: scripts/probe_chirps_coverage.py (live probe PASSED: 153/153 dates, 29 AOI cells, 100% AOI-area coverage), scripts/fetch_chirps_rainfall.py, scripts/prepare_chirps_rainfall.py
sources.cautions: not independent of gauges; not validated; ~5.5 km cells (29 cover the AOI); DAILY_RNL not examined and never combined with SAT

comparison_rules: Do not mix sources in one time series, event total, climatology or anomaly.
Compare sources only side by side on their own native grids, with units, day definitions and resolution stated.
An anomaly needs a same-source, same-grid, multi-year same-calendar-window baseline (default >= 10 years); otherwise it is not computed.
Resampling to 30 m adds no information: label it 'resampled from native' everywhere.
